title: Service Recovery Credit on Commercial Natural Gas Supply Shortfall Corrections
content:
**Term.** A service recovery credit is added to a Commercial Natural Gas Supply shortfall rebill credit for businesses Beacon Ridge has had to correct before:

1. when two or more rebill credit lines were posted on the agreement later than the same calendar day twenty-four months before the correction date, the service recovery credit is $25.00;
2. when exactly one was, it is $10.00;
3. when none was, there is no service recovery credit.

The rebill credit lines are counted from the agreement's own bill lines.

## Counting window (hypothetical correction dated 2025-10-05)

| Rebill credit lines posted on the agreement | Counted lines | Service recovery credit |
|---|---|---|
| 2024-03-12 and 2023-11-30 | 2 | $25.00 |
| 2024-03-12 and 2023-10-05 | 1 (2023-10-05 is not later than the cut-off day) | $10.00 |
| 2023-06-01 | 0 | None |
